title: Implement RoleMiddleware and role policies for Owner/Admin/Kasir
acceptance_criteria: RoleMiddleware reads role from authenticated user and enforces allowed roles
Middleware supports role lists (e.g., owner, admin, kasir)
Policies defined for product, category, stock, transaction, report, user, outlet access
Kasir restricted to transaction endpoints + read-only products + own shift report
Admin cannot create Owner role users
Owner has full access including outlet management
completion_summary: RoleMiddleware role-list (401/403); 7 policy files via Gate + owner bypass; kasir=txn+product-view+own-report, admin blocked from owner users; PolicyServiceProvider; curl-verified
